title: Fernando Mendoza gets first-team reps, impresses at joint practice with Texans

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Fernando Mendoza gets first-team reps, impresses at joint practice with Texans
sources.description: Kirk Cousins has been quarterbacking the Raiders' first string offense throughout training camp, but today rookie Fernando Mendoza got some first-team work at the joint practice with the Texans.
